terbaru.judul: Vanishing correlations in stochastic and bistochastic controlled circuits
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the dynamics of circuits composed of stochastic and bistochastic controlled gates.

terbaru.judul: Remapping and navigation of an embedding space via error minimization: a fundamental organizational principle of cognition in natural and artificial systems
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose that cognition in both natural and synthetic systems can be characterized and understood by the interplay between two equally important invariants: (1) the remapping of embedding spaces, and (2) the navigation within these spaces.

terbaru.judul: Tape: A Cellular Automata Benchmark for Evaluating Rule-Shift Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Across baseline families, we find a consistent ID-to-OOD drop and strong heterogeneity across stable/periodic/chaotic rules.

terbaru.judul: Universality in driven systems with a multiply-degenerate umbilic point
terbaru.pelajaran: Unlike in the bidirectional two-lane model with an umbilic point studied earlier, here we find a robust $z=3/2$ dynamical exponent for the umbilic mode.

terbaru.judul: Emergent togetherness in collaborative dance improvisation: neural and motor synchronization reveal a coupling-decoupling paradox
terbaru.pelajaran: Collective improvisation in dance provides a rich natural laboratory for studying emergent coordination in coupled neuro-motor systems.

terbaru.judul: Visualizing the Structure of Lenia Parameter Space
terbaru.pelajaran: In this abstract, we present a new method to automatically classify Lenia systems into four qualitatively different dynamical classes.

terbaru.judul: Cellular Automata: From Structural Principles to Transport and Correlation Methods
terbaru.pelajaran: \emph{(i)} We present a structural view of CA as shift-commuting maps on configuration spaces, emphasizing rule complexity, reversibility, and conservation laws (including discrete continuity equations).

terbaru.judul: Chaos and thermalization in Clifford-Floquet dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the ergodic properties of a unitary Floquet dynamics arising from the repeated application of a translationally-invariant Clifford Quantum Cellular Automata to an infinite system of qubits in d dimensions.

terbaru.pelajaran: The minimal number of inputs in the local function of a non-trivial cellular automaton is two.
